photo.fileTitle: File:Vienna 2010-11-20 'Kinderrechte' Smart Mob 043 All those formally granted children's rights -- WHERE ARE THEY.jpg
photo.caption: Vienna, Austria; UN Children's Rights day, 2010-11-20.
photo.description: Austria, Vienna, Stephansplatz This shot was taken on "United Nations Children's Rights Day", on 'Stephansplatz', in Vienna, Austria. Besides flanking camera men, the image shows Mr. Franz Prokop (with son) and Gernot Rammer (on mike). It seems to be the first ever organized 'Smart Mob' on such occasion, although it was somewhat misnamed 'flashmob'. This 'smart mob' happened for 60 seconds, beginning at 14:22 local time (13:22_Z). Admittedly, camera's time setting seems to be wrong ~+1min.
